In a single coordinated operation executed on 25 March 2026, the entire CCB (Certidão de Cadeia de Benefícios) validation pipeline was relocated from the aquisicao domain to a newly dedicated documents_validation domain. The move had been in planning for some time — a recognition that the pipeline's scope had outgrown its original home.
